justification: Code review 2026-10-16: state-law rows (source_council NULL) carry internal ids such as provision_2344 in ref_number with section_header NULL. citationIsShown shows the label for source_council NULL whatever citation_status is, and the clause, browse, SEPP and constraint routes passed ref_number through, so an internal id could be displayed as the law's clause number (the DQ-111 fabricated-citation class). One helper, stateClauseLabel in lib/citation-display.ts, now gates every served state reference to real clause shapes; council (DCP) behaviour is unchanged.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: stateClauseLabel('provision_2344') is not null, or withServedCitation on a source_council NULL row with ref_number provision_2344 returns a clause_label
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before the change withServedCitation returned clause_label 'provision_2344' for a state row; the clause route test expected 'Doc__C4_9' and the SEPP parking test expected refNumber 'provision_187' to be served.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: NSW legislation clause numbering (e.g. 2.30AB, 3A.12, Schedule 2 cl 6) as printed in the instrument on legislation.nsw.gov.au

functions.name: stateClauseLabel
functions.input: a stored ref_number of unknown type
functions.output: the trimmed reference if it has the shape of a real NSW clause, section or schedule reference, else null
functions.if_none: caller shows the instrument name and legislation link only, no clause

functions.name: servedClauseLabel
functions.input: a label and the row's source_council
functions.output: council rows: the label unchanged; state rows: stateClauseLabel(label)
functions.if_none: returns null and the caller shows no clause at all

break_it.scenario: internal id shaped like a real clause, e.g. a bare 4+ digit row id or 'Provision 12'
break_it.what_happens: would be shown as a clause
break_it.how: bare integers of 4+ digits and anything containing provision, layout, underscore or a uuid prefix are refused
break_it.repro: jest citation-display: never shows internal ids

break_it.scenario: council row passes through the new gate
break_it.what_happens: a proven DCP label would be dropped
break_it.how: servedClauseLabel only filters when source_council is falsy
break_it.repro: jest citation-display: council rows are unchanged

break_it.scenario: a real state clause in an unlisted format, e.g. Chapter 3 Part 2 Division 1 Subdivision 4
break_it.what_happens: reference hidden; instrument and link still shown

break_it.scenario: an internal id that happens to match the clause shape, e.g. '12'
break_it.what_happens: the id would be shown as a clause number
break_it.how: shape is checked, not truth; short integers are accepted as section numbers

mutation_analysis: Making stateClauseLabel return its input unchanged fails 'never shows internal ids' and 'withServedCitation: state row with internal id'. Making servedClauseLabel filter council rows fails 'council rows are unchanged'.
residual_risk: Sol finding 2 (short bare integers such as 12 pass the shape check) is accepted as residual: shape is checked, not truth. Sol findings 1 (compound Part/Division/Schedule references) and 3 (document-id heuristic failed open) are fixed: stateClauseLabel accepts compound forms and referenceForDocument passes a reference only for a clearly council DCP document id.
